en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a long, one‑and‑a‑half‑storey wooden building with a steep dark roof and several dormer windows, set among tall pine trees. A straight, sand or gravel path leads from the foreground directly to the front door. The setting appears to be a forested or park‑like area. In the lower right corner, handwritten text reads "Sanatorija Krāslavā."
